name: claude-toolkit
description: Portable working conventions, review gates, and design skills for Claude Code

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: The landing-gate workflow: /gemini second-opinion reviews, /springclean taste panels, /spec-sharpen requirements gate with its append-only lens comment trail, /build and /digest role-boundary paths (with a separate test writer and a comment pass after every build), /test-writing, /issue capture, the /intake-signature-/pickup ticket chain with relation and regression scanning and a comment trail on every ticket, self-bootstrapping pickup labels, a bounded reviewer loop and /worktree isolation, /coordinate for one chat that owns a multi-chat release, /ask (grounded Q&A over code, read-only prod data, logs and the tracker), /ticket-format (the company ticket format), /project-setup to seed conventions plus the role-fence hook, the pickup policy, the testing rule, an optional Stop-hook completion check and a read-only tools check, read-only production DB and log access, and the explorer/builder/reviewer agents

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Design and frontend skills: GSAP animation, UI aesthetics (minimalist, premium, industrial-brutalist), mobile app UI, SwiftUI, and product film craft
